mapper.select: select code from wf_business where code = #{code} for update
select exists(select 1 from wf_business where code = #{code})

select b.code, b.name, (#{admin} or g.can_edit) as can_edit, (#{admin} or g.can_publish) as can_publish, (#{admin} or g.can_start) as can_start from wf_business b left join wf_business_grant g on g.business_code = b.code and g.user_id = #{userId} where #{admin} or g.user_id is not null order by b.code
select can_edit, can_publish, can_start from wf_business_grant where business_code = #{code} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from wf_business_grant where business_code = #{code} and user_id = #{userId}
